result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best overall project management tool** if you're building a technology or SaaS company. It's fast, intuitive, lightweight, and particularly good for keeping a small team aligned without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

However, the best choice depends on how your startup operates. A five-person SaaS startup has different needs from a marketing agency or a startup with sales, operations, and product teams.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning
- Great for developers and product teams
- Clean interface with minimal overhead
- Integrates with GitHub and Slack

Website: [linear.app](https://linear.app)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals
- Dashboards and automation
- Useful across product, marketing, sales and operations
- Generous free starting option

Website: [clickup.com](https://clickup.com)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage teams)

- Project tracking and company wiki
- Meeting notes and documentation
- Product plans and company knowledge
- Highly customizable

Website: [notion.so](https://notion.so)

---

![Asana Dashboard Subtasks at Jesse Bellew blog](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/49w0nd8Kfr7uCNekE4GK8-yN3uTUeIefX0UBIinhw5iuaJmOeegzIfGBm6jMwJS1CcJQ3vD0A_Aweq9BIQ6duLOWdnt99Q1ztFE0_AeXX74QHYjh87ua_e9GsI4hT0l2oz9vsVxHgLiEbD0jgDgVvKHlvVA8-ivsRvckvGSF66veBYdO1EoP42zH5H_iWSyG?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

(Best for cross-functional teams)

- Clear task ownership and deadlines
- Project timelines and dependencies
- Excellent for marketing, operations and business teams

Website: [asana.com](https://asana.com)

---

![Monday Vibe | Build Custom Apps with Vibe Coding & AI Prompts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dZbPOy2ExCYPWkRUN-y8aNBArPHAy5RJyF2Fv3kOH8r0onm7GzQMtNgFLnlF_orijMr1L_hlS3rZ5CmII7wcg1sC5QIg6R8JlCgddpaNU2x9UGq4FrFp6DOJXu4JvN0TyREqPyEMky1tg6L3RhInST4tHJiMa0BGxgH61Ibvrnb8NABR1soD10zbitKXa9pg?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday.com**

- Customizable workflows
- Project dashboards and reporting
- Useful as different departments grow

Website: [monday.com](https://monday.com)

## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 people, just starting | Notion |
| 5–15 people, SaaS/product | Linear + Notion |
| 5–20 people, mixed functions | ClickUp |
| 15–50 people, multiple teams | Asana or ClickUp |
| Operations-heavy startup | monday.com |


## What I'd actually implement

For an early-stage startup, I'd avoid buying too many tools.

I'd start with\:

- **Notion\:** Company wiki, strategy, meeting notes and documentation.
- **Linear\:** Product roadmap, engineering tasks and feature development.
- **Slack\:** Team communication.

This gives you a relatively lean operating system without overcomplicating things.
